title: Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 1 October 2026

This policy explains how Ostra, a design studio based in Lisbon, collects and uses personal data when you visit our site or work with us, and the rights you hold under the EU GDPR.

The data we collect

We collect what you send us, such as your name, email, company and brief, plus basic usage data like pages viewed, browser type and rough location, gathered by cookies.

How we use your data

We use it to answer briefs, run projects, send invoices and improve the site, relying on contract, consent or our legitimate interests.

Cookies and site stats

Essential cookies keep the site working. Analytics cookies, which show us which pages are useful, load only after you agree, and you can change that choice anytime.

Who we share it with

We share data only with processors that help us run the studio, such as hosting, email and invoicing tools, under contract. We never sell it.

Storage periods

Enquiries are deleted after 24 months of silence. Project and billing records are kept as long as tax law requires.

Protection

Only people who need personal data can reach it. Accounts use two-factor sign-in, and our providers encrypt data at rest and in transit.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data, or complain to the CNPD, Portugal's data regulator.

Transfers outside the EU

Some of our tools sit outside the EU. When data leaves the EEA, we rely on adequacy decisions or Standard Contractual Clauses.

Children's data

Our services are for businesses. We do not knowingly collect data from children, and we delete any that reaches us.

If this policy changes

If we change how we handle data, we will update this page and its date. Bigger changes get a notice on the site.

Questions?

Email hello@ostra.studio with any privacy question or data request.
